\[
W = \begin{bmatrix}
  20 & 20 & 200 \\
  20 & 20 & 200 \\
  20 & 20 & 200
\end{bmatrix}
\]

The window lies on a vertical edge, dark on the left and bright on the right.

| Output | Value |
|---|---|
| Gx | 720 |
| Gy | 0 |
| Magnitude (L2) | 720 |
| Direction | 0 degrees |

Gx = (200 - 20) x (1 + 2 + 1) = 720. Gy is 0, because the top and bottom rows are equal. The direction 0 degrees points from dark to bright, along +x.
